# Bombay Oxygen Investments Ltd — BSE 509470 (`$BOMOXY-B1`)

*A quick fundamentals + valuation workup, 09 Jul 2026 (market close).*

## Snapshot

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Last price | **₹18,860.65** (+0.63% on the day) |
| Market cap | **₹2,829 crore** |
| Shares outstanding | **1.5 lakh** (extremely thin float) |
| Sector / Industry | Financial Services — Asset Management |
| 52-week high / low | ₹31,998 / ₹18,500 |
| 52-week change | **−25.1%** |
| Drawdown from high | **−41.1%** |
| Beta | 0.086 (near-zero market correlation) |

Source: BSE quote + Yahoo Finance fundamentals [1].

---

## Valuation — trading at a steep discount to book

- **Price / Book: 0.60×** — the stock trades at a ~40% discount to its book value of **₹31,508 per share**.
- **P/E: N/A** — the company is loss-making (TTM EPS **−₹215.54**), so earnings-based multiples are undefined.
- **EV/EBITDA: N/A** (negative EBITDA).
- **Price/Sales: N/A** (TTM revenue is negative at −₹1.96 cr, suggesting write-backs or non-operational income/cost structure rather than a going-concern revenue line).

**Interpretation:** The entire investment case rests on the **book-value discount**. At 0.60× book, the market is pricing in either asset-quality concerns, illiquidity, or a persistent inability to monetise the underlying assets. There is no earnings power to underwrite.

---

## Dividends — token yield, not an income stock

- **Dividend per share: ₹25** (annualised).
- **Dividend yield: ~0.13%** on the current price.
- TTM dividend field was null in the feed, so the ₹25 figure should be treated as the most recent declared dividend, not a confirmed trailing-twelve-month payout.

A 0.13% yield on a ₹18,860 stock is negligible — this is not a dividend-income play. The payout appears symbolic relative to the share price.

---

## Quality & financials — loss-making, no revenue engine

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Revenue (TTM) | **−₹1.96 crore** |
| Net income (TTM) | **−₹3.24 crore** |
| Free cash flow (TTM) | **−₹2.37 crore** |
| ROE | **−0.68%** |
| ROA | **−0.50%** |
| Gross margin | 0% |
| Operating margin | 101.7%* |
| Current ratio | 28.2× |
| Quick ratio | 14.1× |
| Debt/equity | N/A |

*The 101.7% operating margin on negative revenue is a mathematical artefact, not a sign of profitability.

**Takeaway:** Despite a fortress balance sheet (current ratio 28×, virtually no debt), the company generates **no operating revenue and is bleeding cash**. The liquidity is real but unproductive — it sits idle while the P&L deteriorates. The "Investments" in the name suggests the company is an investment-holding vehicle; its returns depend on asset/portfolio performance, not operations.

---

## Ownership — promoter-controlled, illiquid

- **Promoter / insider holding: 75.8%**
- **Institutional holding: 8.5%**
- Public float: ~15.7% of 1.5 lakh shares = **~23,600 shares** in public hands.

With only ~24,000 shares in public hands at ~₹18,860 each, the total public float is worth roughly **₹44 crore**. Daily volumes are negligible (the feed reported null volume on the last close). This is a **structurally illiquid** stock — entry/exit will move the price and bid-ask spreads will be wide.

---

## Price action

- Down **25%** over the trailing 52 weeks and **41%** off its 52-week high of ₹31,998.
- Currently sitting just above the 52-week low of ₹18,500 — the stock is near its cheapest level in a year.
- Beta of 0.086 means it moves almost independently of the broader market; price action is driven by idiosyncratic, low-volume trading.

---

## Bottom line

**Bombay Oxygen Investments is a deep-value/asset-play stock with no earnings and negligible dividends.** The thesis is purely: *can you buy assets at 60 paise on the rupee and eventually realise that value?*

| Bull case | Bear case |
|---|---|
| 0.60× book value — large margin of safety if assets are real and realisable | No revenue, consistent losses, negative free cash flow |
| Fortress liquidity (28× current ratio, no debt) | Cash is idle, not compounding — no operating engine |
| Promoter skin in the game (75.8%) | Extreme illiquidity — ~24k public shares, near-zero volume |
| Near 52-week low — mean-reversion candidate | 0.13% dividend yield offers no income support |
| | No identified catalyst for value unlock in this run |

**This is a speculative deep-value situation, not a quality compounder.** The book-value discount is the only real pillar; everything else (earnings, dividends, growth) is absent. Proceed only if you have a view on the underlying asset portfolio and a path to value realisation.

---

- No company-specific news or corporate announcements were retrieved in this run. No SEC/BSE filings were fetched. The analysis is built entirely from live price + fundamentals data.
